purpose: Hold a conversation with one person or a group.
layout: Header with the other party's avatar and status, then message bubbles (mine right in accent, theirs left in surface) with timestamps grouped by day, then a composer pinned at the bottom.

required: Header with avatar, name and status
Message bubbles, two sides, with day separator
Composer pinned to the bottom with send button
optional: Quick reply chips above the composer

avoid: Both sides in the same colour
